critic_accepts.instructions: Would a skeptical critic of the author agree that `criterion` is a fair test of `claim` at the stated `bar`?

criteria.false: The criterion tests something the claim did not assert, or is so loose that almost anything would satisfy it, or so tight that no reasonable reading of the claim could.
